Gattaca is a sci-fi film set in a future where genetic engineering is common.

It has a good mix of action, drama, and philosophical themes.
Now, looking at the options: (A) Brave, (B) Dredd, (C) When Worlds Collide, (D) Go.

Option D is Go.
